description_en: Removes objects from e-commerce images by automatically identifying and erasing text, specific names, transparent text blocks, and watermarks. Allows you to specify objects to remove as needed, enabling efficient and accurate processing of large batches of images and simplifying image editing
description_zh: 图像智能消除产品专为电商图片定制，自动识别并消除电商图片中的文字、特定名称、透明字块和牛皮癣，可按需指定消除图片内对象，实现大批量图片的高效、精确处理，简化图片编辑工作
name: ImageRemovalProAsync

parameters.help_en:
The URL of the original image. The image must be in the JPG, JPEG, PNG, BMP, or WEBP format.
· Resolution: 256×256 to 3000×3000. File size: ≤ 10 MB
